decisions.reason: The safety shoe line gained a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and it belongs to the firm's core business, so keeping the option open costs little.
The comfort insole was only mentioned on the website in both years, so its value is still uncertain, but as a cheap accessory within a broad insole range it is not worth abandoning yet.
The supportive insole shows no increase in visibility and overlaps with the other insoles, but it costs little to carry, so the firm keeps it while uncertainty resolves.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has held a page of its own in both years, which indicates sustained investment in a core segment.
The firefighter boots moved from a mention to a page of their own, which suggests the option is proving valuable and justifies further commitment.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page and has a concrete customer success with ALBA Braunschweig, so its value is being realized.
